english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a harmful microbe or germs in general.
Use 細菌 as the everyday all-purpose term, especially when talking about microbes as germs or harmful bacteria.

examples.english: Wash your hands—there could be a germ on the doorknob.
examples.traditional: 洗手啦，門柄上面隨時有一粒細菌。
examples.jyutping: sai2 sau2 laa1 mun4 beng3 soeng6 min6 ceoi4 si4 jau5 jat1 lap1 sai3 kwan2

examples.english: A microbe can easily spread from a hand to food.
examples.traditional: 一粒細菌好容易由隻手傳到食物度。
examples.jyutping: jat1 nap1 sai3 kwan2 hou2 jung4 ji6 jau4 zek3 sau2 cyun4 dou3 sik6 mat6 dou6
